Generated by `corpus:docs` from the corpus's `manifest.json` — regenerate with
`CORPUS_DIR=<path> pnpm --filter @waxlens/core corpus:docs`.

The `$schema` column is what each specimen's `datapackage.json` declares. Only
`datapackage-schema-only` carries a value; the rest name their contract with v1's
`profile` and so read `—` (see [manifest.json](../manifest/)).

The catalogue above is generated by `corpus:docs` from the corpus's
`manifest.json`. That file is plain JSON and outside LFS, so regenerating the
catalogue needs neither the archives themselves nor `git lfs pull`.

Each specimen records which rules it is expected to trip and under which
profile, which is what makes the corpus usable as a fixture set: a change in
rule behaviour shows up as a diff in expectations, not as a mystery.
